claims: No. 9 seed Iowa defeated No. 4 seed Nebraska 77-71.
The game was in the 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16.
The game occurred on March 26, 2026.
The game was at Toyota Center, Houston.
The game was the NCAA South Region Semifinal.
Bennett Stirtz scored 20 points for Iowa.
Pryce Sandfort scored 25 points for Iowa.
Rienk Mast scored 9 points for Nebraska.
Jamarques Lawrence scored 9 points for Nebraska.
Nebraska led for 32 minutes of the game.
Nebraska had a 14-4 run early in the game.
Iowa took its first lead with 2:10 remaining in the game.
Nebraska had only four defenders on the floor late in the game.
Alvaro Folgueiras scored a 3-point play.
The 3-point play gave Iowa a 74-68 lead with under a minute left.
Iowa advanced to the Elite Eight for the first time since 1987.
Nebraska finished the season 28-7.
Nebraska's 28-7 season was a school record.
Nebraska achieved their first-ever NCAA Tournament win earlier in the tournament.
Iowa rallied from an early deficit to win.
